name: brain-corp-agent-skills
description: Official Agensi skill pack for orchestrating multi-repository SDD and ticket workflows with @rgkoko/brain-corp.

skills.name: brain-corp-setup
skills.description: Set up a brain-corp workspace, register sidecars and initialize the CLI session.

skills.name: brain-corp-analysis
skills.description: Analyze the ecosystem and create actionable tickets from integration gaps.

skills.name: brain-corp-sdd
skills.description: Run the native Spec-Driven Development flow for a ticket.

skills.name: brain-corp-ticket-ops
skills.description: Import, normalize, validate, sync, close and hotfix tickets.

skills.name: brain-corp-pr
skills.description: Create a pull request from a ticket with the bundled EN/ES template.
